title: add downgrade guard, version pinning and backup/restore hooks for private-installer
author: Ritika Sinha
description: Context: Customers running Redwood Private in regulated environments need robust upgrade and rollback guarantees. This PR implements a set of coordinated changes across the private-installer Helm chart, Terraform module, and the installer runtime to provide: (1) downgrade guards that prevent applying a release that would downgrade DB schema or critical component versions, (2) version pinning so critical system components (postgres chart, migration runner, controller) are locked during upgrades to avoid implicit drifting, and (3) orchestrated backup/restore hooks with verification and an automated rollback path. Motivation: We observed two post-upgrade incidents where chained upgrades caused schema mismatches on rollback and left nodes unusable; this is intended to make upgrades safe and auditable. Changes include a migration-aware guard, pre/post upgrade backup hooks, a verified restore path for failed upgrades, and feature flags to toggle behavior during staged rollouts. Checklist: - [x] Add downgrade guard logic and config knobs - [x] Add helm hooks for pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade verification - [x] Add Terraform module outputs for backup locations and KMS keys - [x] Add CLI flag to the installer to enforce pinning during upgrade - [x] Add integration tests for backup/restore and downgrade guard - [x] Update docs and upgrade runbook Testing/verification: See testing_summary. Rollout plan: ship to canary Dedicated and Private clusters with downgrade guard disabled by default, enable in staged rollout after 24h successful canary, then enable by default in next minor release. In emergency rollback scenario the installer will run verification and either allow safe rollback or block the rollback with actionable diagnostics for operator intervention.

release_notes: Adds downgrade guard to prevent unsafe downgrades when schema or component versions would be incompatible.
Introduces version pinning support for critical charts and migration runner to stabilize upgrade behavior.
Adds pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade verification hooks with automated restore path.
Exposes terraform outputs for backup locations and KMS configuration to integrate with cloud infra.
Docs: Expanded upgrade runbook with canary rollout and emergency rollback steps.
migration_plan: Recommended process: 1) Run helm upgrade in canary namespace with --set downgradeGuard.enabled=false and --set backup.enabled=true to validate backups. 2) Monitor verification metrics for 24h. 3) Enable downgradeGuard on canary and run upgrade. 4) If verification passes, schedule cluster rollout in waves. For emergency rollbacks use installer --force-rollback only after confirming backup verification artifacts are present.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover downgrade guard logic and config parsing. Integration tests validate helm hooks and Terraform outputs. e2e tests simulate a failed migration and exercise backup/restore flow. CI originally experienced a flaky e2e due to S3 throttling; added retries and tests now pass consistently. Manual validation performed on an internal canary cluster with a synthetic dataset and simulated migration failures.
notes: This is part of ENG-4123 and coordinated with platform and SRE. Follow-up work: add encrypted snapshots and restore dry-run mode (ENG-4257).
